data.location: 2888–2890B N University Drive, Coral Springs, FL 33065
data.short_description: La Fontana Pizzeria and Italian Restaurant, a family-owned restaurant in Coral Springs, announced it will permanently close after 18 years of operation. The owners, brothers Spartaco and Antonio Tare, shared the news on social media on May 27, 2026, with the final day of service set for Father's Day, June 21, 2026. The owners cited a difficult decision and announced plans to return to Europe.

Plank, an approximately 50,000 sq ft entertainment and dining venue at Jack London Square in Oakland, announced it will permanently close after nearly 12 years in operation. The closure was announced on Instagram on May 30, 2026, citing a significant and persistent drop in sales and rising costs over the past two years. The final day of operation is scheduled for Sunday, August 2, 2026.

Bar Peached sustained significant fire damage in the early morning hours of May 31, 2026, forcing a temporary closure. The fire broke through the roof and was controlled by 6:51 a.m.; no injuries were reported. The restaurant remains closed until further notice and has encouraged guests to visit its sister concept, Peached Tortilla, in the meantime.

Famous Dave's has opened a new BBQ location in Victorville, California, operated by Bluestone Hospitality Group. The restaurant opened on May 29, 2026, featuring pit-smoked BBQ, a full-service bar with over 20 beers, and dine-in, takeout, and catering services. The space is designed for family meals, business lunches, and game-day gatherings with multiple TVs throughout.

Giordano's, a Chicago-based deep-dish pizza chain, will open a 7,400-square-foot restaurant in the Lafayette Square neighborhood of Washington, D.C. on June 9, 2026. The location will seat more than 180 guests across a dining room, a 16-seat bar, a 20-seat private dining room (The Lincoln Room), and a 20-seat seasonal patio. The opening will feature a limited-edition "250 Pizza" marking America's 250th anniversary.

data.location: 5 Front Street, Brooklyn (Dumbo), NY (zip code not specified)
data.short_description: Titán, a Northern Mexican restaurant and bar led by Chef Alan Delgado and Beverage Director Ivy Mix, will open on June 17, 2026, in Brooklyn's Dumbo neighborhood. The restaurant is housed in a historic building built in 1824 and features a rear garden patio with direct views of the Brooklyn Bridge. The menu focuses on flavors, ingredients, and cooking methods of Northern Mexico, inspired by Delgado's childhood at the U.S.-Mexico border.

CEO Jason Wang expressed enthusiasm about the expansion, noting the business remains family-owned with no investors or franchisees.

A second location is also being prepared at 5333 Adeline St in Oakland, though opening timelines for both remain unclear. data.status: plans to open a second location this summer
data.short_description: Nantasket Sweets By Swedes, a South Shore Swedish candy and confections shop originally located in Hull, is opening a second location at 115 Charles St in Boston's Beacon Hill neighborhood. Owner Maria Stolt, originally from Sweden, launched the original Hull shop on Christmas Eve 2020. The Beacon Hill location will offer the same Swedish pick-and-mix candy, handcrafted chocolates, fudge, caramels, ice cream, and seasonal specialties as the original.

data.location: 967 N. Academy Ave, New Braunfels, TX (zip code not specified)
data.status: aiming for a June opening; yet to be confirmed
data.short_description: Wine Folks, a locally owned wine bar and bottle shop led by husband-and-wife duo Danielle and Jason Grantham, is set to open at 967 N. Academy Ave in New Braunfels. The team is aiming for a June opening, though it has not yet been confirmed. The concept will offer beer, wine, provisions, retail wine and craft beer bottles, artisan snacks, and a bar and lounge area with wine by the glass, draft beer, and non-alcoholic options.

Dar Rafiki's, a popular family-owned Moroccan-inspired bakery and café, is opening a second location at 687-719 South Main St in Bradford's Academy Plaza, next to Teos Tacos and New Moon Garden. The new space is currently being renovated and will be noticeably larger than the original downtown Haverhill location at 389 Main Street, with expanded seating. The Breakfast Club at Midtown is preparing to open its first San Francisco location at 1428 Haight Street, becoming the brand's first outpost in the city. Construction is actively progressing, but an official opening date has not been finalized; franchisee Timothy Guess is targeting a late summer debut pending renovations and required inspections. The brand is known for its extensive breakfast and brunch menu featuring items like the Cowboy Benedict, Chicken & Waffle, and Tiramisu Pancakes.

Chef and entrepreneur Palak Patel has announced plans to open a new Indian restaurant in Billerica, MA, though the restaurant's name, exact address, and opening timeline have not yet been disclosed. Patel confirmed the restaurant is currently under construction, with additional details to be released as the project progresses. The concept is expected to draw on the authentic Indian flavors from Patel's prior catering and tiffin service, Palak's Creations, which she has closed.

data.location: 1 Harborside Drive, Terminal C, East Boston, MA 02128
data.short_description: Mike's Pastry, the iconic North End bakery founded in 1946, is expanding to Terminal C at Boston Logan International Airport. The new location will be its fifth overall and first inside an airport, offering cannoli, lobster tails, cookies, cheesecake slices, and a full espresso bar. The space will blend old-school North End roots with a modern, travel-friendly design.

Dolan Uyghur Restaurant is opening its fifth location in Arlington, VA, as announced by owner Hamid Kerim via a Facebook post seeking staff. No specific address or opening timeline has been publicly shared. The chain currently operates locations in Chantilly, Falls Church, Rockville, and Washington, DC.

The Charlotte location would be the concept's second, with the first operating inside The Westin St. Francis in San Francisco. It will join Bourbon Steak and Sweet July Café as part of the broader Curry-Mina collaboration at the property.

Grandioso is a new pizza and neighborhood bar concept planned for 1227 Grand Ave in Phoenix by restaurateur Justin Piazza. The restaurant will feature four pizza styles — New York, Roman taglio, Detroit, and tavern — alongside a full bar, baked wings, and panino-style sandwiches. While the team initially aimed for July 1, Piazza indicated July 15 is the more likely opening date.

Fresh Monkee's first Sarasota location, operated by franchisee Magda Reyes, is set to soft open on June 1, offering 50% off shakes through June 5. The shake franchise serves protein-based healthy shakes across multiple categories and is part of a broader Florida expansion with eight more locations in the pipeline. This is one of three planned Fresh Monkee locations Reyes intends to open in the area.

data.location: 468 Quay Commons, Suite G, Sarasota, FL 34236

This will be Lojo's third Foxtail location, following openings in Carrollwood and near USF. The new café will serve espresso-based drinks and cold brew to meet demand for a coffee shop in the developing waterfront area.

Fresh Monkee is preparing to open a new location in Lakeland at 5257 US Hwy 98 S, joining Highland City Town Center anchored by Publix. No specific opening date has been announced. The Cameron Road location is also expected to serve tortas, tacos, and quesadillas.

data.location: 1910 Wells Rd, Orange Park, FL 32073 (Orange Park Mall)

The menu will differ slightly from the original but will retain familiar offerings alongside new surprises. The restaurant combines Japanese and Thai cuisine in a modern setting with a full bar and cocktail program.

Cafecito, a South Bay-based Hispanic-inspired coffee shop, is preparing to open a new downtown San Diego location at 1088 Park Boulevard near San Diego City College, moving into the former Smarts Cafe space. Documents have been submitted to the San Diego Department of Environmental Health and Quality, though no exact opening date has been announced. The new shop will offer espresso drinks, pastries, and quick bites consistent with the brand's current offerings.

Beignets and Brew is opening a 1,500-square-foot location in Herndon Centre at 348 Elden St, with franchisee Travis Loan operating the concept. The fast-casual eatery will serve French-style beignets with dipping sauces alongside hot and frozen coffee drinks. Construction is well underway and the opening is set for June 20, 2026.

Nobu is planning its first Pacific Northwest restaurant at Avenue Bellevue, occupying approximately 10,000 square feet within the mixed-use development. The restaurant will be part of the newly announced Nobu Residences Bellevue project owned by Silverstein Properties. The concept will feature Nobu's signature Japanese cuisine with Peruvian and South American influences.

Parker's Kitchen, a Savannah-based restaurant-and-gas-station brand, is planning its first St. Johns County location at 1020 FL-16 in St. Augustine, across from The Shoppes at Mission Trace. The location was reported based on submitted paperwork cited by the Jacksonville Daily Record. The brand operates at least 102 stores in Georgia and South Carolina and is expanding into the Northeast Florida market.

Jay Ruff is opening a new air travel-themed cocktail bar and small plates concept called The Layover at 10271 Calumet Avenue in St. John, Indiana, targeting a first-week-of-September opening. The bar is currently under construction and will feature a menu divided into carry-on, layovers, first class, and final call categories alongside specialty cocktails. Ruff previously opened Lincoln & Wicker in Schererville and has experience as an executive chef at Lassen's Tap in Homewood.

data.short_description: Bayou Brew Coffee Co. is a Louisiana-inspired coffee shop planned for Powder Springs, GA, targeting an August opening. The 1,400-square-foot space will feature chicory coffee, beignets, and New Orleans-inspired décor.

7 Brew is opening its second Jonesboro location at 1701 Visions Avenue in the Hilltop area, with a grand opening set for June 22 and week-long free coffee promotions. The drive-thru café will operate Sunday–Thursday 5:30 am–10 pm and Friday–Saturday 5:30 am–11 pm.

Bibibop is expanding to East Lansing, marking its first Michigan location, with the store currently under construction though no address or opening date has been confirmed. The chain is known for its buildable bowls with a base of rice or noodles, proteins, toppings, and sauces.

Birista House, a Hyderabad-cuisine restaurant, plans to open its second U.S. location in Irving, TX, with construction projected to begin in September 2026 and completion expected by June 2027. The owner confirmed the project is several months away from opening and more details may be available closer to mid-June.

data.location: 137 N Main St, Walnut Cove, NC 27052
data.status: entering a new chapter under new ownership
data.short_description: Creations Coffee Co. in Walnut Cove has undergone an ownership transition, with Justin and Ashley Duncan taking over the faith-based coffee shop that was nearing closure. The new owners plan to preserve the community-focused mission and atmosphere established since its 2022 founding.

Sweet July Café, from Ayesha Curry's lifestyle brand, is preparing to open at The Ritz-Carlton Charlotte targeting a July debut, offering coffee, baked goods, smoothies, and café fare with Jamaican-inspired menu items. The concept is operated in partnership with The MINA Group and has an existing location at Regent Santa Monica Beach in California.

Five Iron Golf is preparing to open at 609 Ryan St in Lake Charles, the former Blue Dog Café location, featuring a full restaurant and bar, 10 golf simulators, and virtual sports. The expected opening is late November, with co-owners Boyer and Benoit describing it as the first Five Iron Golf location in the South.

data.status: preparing to open its second location
data.short_description: Peaky Peak Coffee and Charcuterie is planning a second location at 1075 Bannock Street in Denver's Modera Golden Triangle, occupying a 1,644-square-foot space with capacity for over 70 people. The concept, owned by Tracy and Quy Nguyen, specializes in authentic Vietnamese coffee and transitions to wine, cocktails, and charcuterie in the evenings.

Ometeo, a modern Tex-Mex concept from D.C.-based Long Shot Hospitality, is preparing to open at 50 Peabody Street in Nashville's South Bank neighborhood within the Peabody Union mixed-use development. The restaurant, developed with Top Chef winner Gabe Erales, will emphasize live-fire cooking and ingredients sourced from the South and Gulf Coast.

data.status: potential changes indicated by permit filing
data.short_description: A permit filed under the name "Abyssinia" at the address currently occupied by Queen Sheba Ethiopian Restaurant & Bar suggests a possible rebranding, new concept, or operational change. No formal announcement has been made and the owner declined to provide specific details, indicating more information would be shared once plans are finalized.

data.status: currently targeting an October or November opening, pending permit approvals
data.short_description: La Victoria Cocina Mexicana is expanding to Raleigh with a new location at 2519 Fairview Road, targeting an October or November opening pending permit approvals. The restaurant will be the second location for the concept, which currently operates in Cary.

Sho Pizza Bar is planning a second Nashville-area location targeting a space at 54 White Bridge Pike in West Nashville, taking over a former Sports Seasons retail space. No opening timeline has been announced for the Tokyo-inspired neo-Neapolitan pizza concept founded by Mary Carlisle Gambill, Ben Gambill, and chef Sean Brock.

Tanhuo Yanji BBQ is planned for 524 6th Ave S, the former location of Shanghai Garden, according to Washington State Liquor and Cannabis Board licensing information. Few details have been released and no opening timeline has been announced.

Petite Lucie, a French-inspired café, bakery, and garden bar from Culinary Matters, is soft opening on May 30 at Market Square Park in Downtown Houston. The concept features a covered dining pavilion, indoor-outdoor cocktail bar, and open kitchen, operating daily from 7 a.m. to 9 p.m.

Chim Chim Thai is planned for 13802 N Scottsdale Rd #130 in Scottsdale, according to Arizona Department of Liquor Licenses and Control records, with ownership under Kin Wah Lum and Chim Chim Group LLC. No opening timeline or menu details have been publicly announced.

data.status: in the design and planning stages
data.short_description: Buffalo-inspired chicken wing chain Atomic Wings is planning its first Ohio location near Ohio State University's campus. The franchise owner confirmed a target opening before the college football season, though the project is currently in design and planning. The menu will feature fresh never-frozen halal wings, tenders, sandwiches, and flavored dirty sodas.

data.status: aiming for a July opening date
data.short_description: Owner Sergio Barbone submitted a liquor license application for Osteria Gilberto, an Italian concept coming to Lincoln Park's Webster and Magnolia corner. Barbone declined to share further details at this time but is targeting a July opening. He also owns Bakehouse Chicago, with locations in Lakeview, Roscoe Village, and Southport.

Owner Alex Lewis is opening a wine-and-cheese concept beside Marblehead House of Pizza, featuring small plates, charcuterie, grilled cheeses, and zero-proof options in an inclusive, all-ages atmosphere. Lewis is currently hiring and building excitement through weekly tastings and pairing events ahead of the grand opening. The timeline remains dependent on final preparations and hiring.

Operators Tina McCarthy, Chad Ingram, and Rob Johnston are developing a boutique hotel in downtown Aiken incorporating the historic Farmers and Merchants Bank Building and adjacent property. The four-story new build will include 84 rooms, suites, extended-stay residences, a lobby bar, and garden courtyard, while the historic renovation will house a restaurant, bar, meeting rooms, and fitness space. The restaurant name and menu are still being finalized.
